pages.title: Shafts
pages.text: One shaft per wood; most carry a modifier.$(br)$(li)$(l)Jungle$(): Bounce$(li)$(l)Acacia$(): Boost$(li)$(l)Dark Oak$(): Pierce$(li)$(l)Mangrove$(): Slower$(li)$(l)Cherry$(): Health Steal$(li)$(l)Pale Oak$(): Backstab$(li)$(l)Crimson$(): Executioner$(li)$(l)Warped$(): Translocation

$(l)Bounce$(): ricochets up to 3 times. $(l)Boost$(): +40% speed after 0.5s. $(l)Pierce$(): passes through one enemy. $(l)Slower$(): Slowness III. $(l)Health Steal$(): heals you on hit. $(l)Backstab$(): +40% from behind. $(l)Executioner$(): +50% below half health. $(l)Translocation$(): swaps you and the target.

pages.title: Fletchings
pages.text: Fletchings tune accuracy and stability.$(br)$(li)$(l)Feather$(): 1.0x$(li)$(l)Rigid$(): 0.84x$(li)$(l)Trailing$(): 0.75x, Stable$(li)$(l)Serrated$(): Homing$(li)$(l)Bound$(): Recovery$(li)$(l)Vex$(): Ghostly$(br2)$(l)Coloured feathers$() (parrot/eagle drops) are cosmetic variants of Feather.
